success_path: Database preflight succeeds; onboarding completion persists; route enters shell
failure_recovery: Database open/timeout shows local recovery and retry; incomplete flag redirects to onboarding

success_path: Valid selected person writes to local repository; birthday occurrence reconciles; list updates
failure_recovery: Field/row diagnostics, permission denial, persistence error, undo path; device export/share not independently exercised

success_path: Occurrence is planned with enabled reminder settings and a person-linked destination
failure_recovery: Past/duplicate events excluded; quiet hours suppress/defer; permission, reboot, timezone and stale target require device recovery verification

journey_name: Compose review and hand off greeting
success_path: Editable draft persists; user reviews and initiates a supported external handoff; optional explicit confirmation is recorded
failure_recovery: AI lock/provider/timeout yields typed recovery or manual writing; handoff failure retains draft; never infer sent from app return

success_path: Explicit backup writes a validated generation then advances pointer; confirmed restore validates before local apply
failure_recovery: Auth/network/manifest/partial-write failure is surfaced; local state and previous pointer must remain recoverable; production rules not exercised

success_path: Play purchase is verified with authenticated App Check request; valid owner entitlement is returned
failure_recovery: Pending/cancelled/expired/mismatched purchase does not grant entitlement; real Play and deployed verifier remain unverified

journey_name: Public account deletion request and receipt
data_entities_or_store_paths: Server deletion fence, tombstone and receipt paths
success_path: Configured site obtains recent reauthentication and App Check, requests deletion, and can check private receipt
failure_recovery: Missing release config disables controls; auth/App Check/ambiguous result remains fail-closed; local device data and external copies are not erased
